rule: Nothing below is implemented unless its state says otherwise. Each open suggestion stays OPEN until you choose one option. A recommended path is not a decision. A row marked DELIVERED was completed by a later integration session and is kept for the record.

suggestions.title: Find a source for opening and closing prices (the locked-Thursday line is already captured)
blocks: Every ROI, closing-line value and staking figure
suggestions.problem: CORRECTED 2026-11-15: the earlier claim 'No official NFL page publishes a betting line' is FALSE. nfl.com publishes a FanDuel line for every game in its weekly picks article, locked 2 p.m. ET Thursday (87 snapshot values now recorded in ledger/data/price-snapshots.json). What remains true: no official source publishes an OPENING or CLOSING number, so 0 of 78 opening and closing values in the price store can be verified.

options.label: Licensed odds feed chosen by you
options.cost: Subscription price not verified here; to be quoted by the provider.
options.risk: A licensed feed is not an official NFL source. Market rows would need their own provenance gate and be labelled as licensed, not official.

options.label: Keep the store blank; no ROI
options.risk: No ROI, CLV or staking result can ever be computed. The leaderboard stays signal-only.

options.label: Check first whether an official NFL data partner publishes lines
options.risk: The secondary press report says official data goes to sportsbook partners through Genius Sports; no official NFL price page was found.

suggestions.title: Approve, tighten or loosen the demotion thresholds
suggestions.problem: The demotion gate (rules D1-D8) is written but its thresholds are proposals. Until approved it is inert, and no strategy can be LIVE.

options.label: Adopt as written
options.risk: Rules are written before any live window exists, which is the protection against tuning to results. The 14-day staleness rule (D8) is a judgement call.

options.label: Tighten (e.g. 7-day staleness, larger samples)
options.cost: Fewer strategies can ever go LIVE.
options.risk: Slower to act on a real edge.

options.label: Loosen (smaller samples)
options.risk: Weaker evidence; conflicts with the G3 sample gates already fixed in origination.

suggestions.title: What to do with the total, whose model fails validation
suggestions.problem: The total model S4 fails G4, G5 and G6 (p_holm = 1.0). The fair totals on the lines page are shown but UNVALIDATED.

options.label: Keep publishing totals, labelled UNVALIDATED
options.risk: Readers may still read a number as a forecast.

options.label: Withdraw totals until a model passes
Pre-register a new total model and test it on a new window
options.cost: Needs new evaluation weeks; no result exists yet.
options.risk: Looking at the same weeks again would reuse the data that failed.

suggestions.title: Resolve the G7 applicability error for the two parlays
blocks: Origination gate record for S9 and S10
suggestions.problem: S9 and S10 are probability products but G7 was not computed, so origination recorded it as null, which its verdict code does not count as a failure. Verdicts are unchanged because both fail other gates.

options.label: Keep origination as published; the ledger counts it as FAIL
options.risk: The origination record still shows a null gate.

options.label: Re-run origination with G7 computed, as a new dated artifact
options.risk: New numbers appear for the same weeks, so this needs its own review.

suggestions.title: Constant spread across all games
suggestions.problem: One sigma (12.61 for margin, 13.72 for total) is used for all 13 games, so every moneyline assumes the same spread of outcomes.

options.label: Keep and label as an assumption
options.risk: Moneylines for mismatches are overstated or understated.

options.label: Fit a game-specific spread in a new pre-registered test
options.risk: More parameters on a small sample.

suggestions.title: Who is starting and who is replacing a starter (2nd, 3rd, 4th string)
blocks: Requirement to track replacement depth before the game
suggestions.problem: No pre-game depth chart is published by nfl.com (the depth-chart URL returns 404; see decision/data/availability-probe.json). The official injury report names who is out, but not who replaces them.

options.label: Track starters only after each game from the official Game Book PDF
options.cost: Manual-free capture is possible only if the PDF URL pattern is confirmed.
options.risk: Information arrives after the game, so it can only grade, not forecast.
